alt_summaries.summary: Act 1 town of exile survivors on the coast, named after General Marceus Lioneye; conquered by Kaom's Karui in the past.
Coastal refugee town on the Twilight Strand; Act 1 town and, in Part Two, the Act 6 town where Tarkleigh, Bestel, Lilly Roth and Sin await the exile.

nodes.name: Lira Vaal / Atziri's Temple
nodes.summary: Royal temple of Atziri and Vaal capital for much of its history; rebuilt by Xipocado and Doryani as a self-reconstructing marvel. PoE2 Fate of the Vaal league lets players modify its layout.

nodes.name: The Lord's Labyrinth
nodes.summary: A labyrinth built by Emperor Izaro in 1317 IC as a test to choose his successor, opened on the second Galvano of Azmeri. Chitus won it by betraying Weylin, and later sealed Izaro inside. In PoE1 it is the Act 1 quest that leads to the Trials of Ascendancy.
sources: section 'Reign of Izaro' and 'The Lord's Labyrinth'

alt_summaries.summary: Trap-filled maze built by Emperor Izaro in Sarn to pick his successor, opened 1317 IC. Chitus won it; the exile later challenges it to earn ascendancy points.

nodes.name: The Lunaris Temple
nodes.summary: Temple on west side of Sarn, Piety's laboratory filled with miscreations.
sources: Maramoa on The Dusk and the Moon Orb

alt_summaries.summary: Sarn temple holding the Moon Orb, guarded by the exile 'Dusk'.

nodes.name: Maligaro's Sanctum
nodes.summary: A map-like area in Act 7 entered through portals opened with Maligaro's Map from the Chamber of Sins; the Artist Maligaro and his pet spider Black Death are fought here.
sources: Walkthrough: 'You have opened the portals using his Map, now enter Maligaro's Sanctum.'
Walkthrough: 'Maligaro's Sanctum is a map-like area. Player consumes one portal to enter the area'

nodes.name: Memory Nexus
nodes.summary: Hub area of Synthesis where captured Fragmented Memories are placed to form paths to rewards, enhancements and boss memories.

alt_summaries.summary: Synthesis hub in the Atlas where stabilised memories are connected into paths to memory bosses like the Cortex.

nodes.name: Merveil's Lair
nodes.summary: Act 1 boss area at the end of the Cavern of Anger.

nodes.name: Middengard
nodes.summary: Distant continent south-east of Wraeclast on which Kalguur lies.

alt_summaries.summary: Distant continent east/southeast of Wraeclast on which Kalguur lies.
Distant continent south-east of Wraeclast, homeland of the Kalguur; ruled by a king named Cadigan; it cannot be directly visited in the games.

nodes.name: Monastery of the Keepers
nodes.summary: Southern Atlas site; hidden chamber houses the Dreamer; Genesis Tree and Grasping Orchid located here.
sources: Visit the Monastery of the Keepers
hidden area in the Monastery of the Keepers
Monastery of the Keepers to grow a Grasping Orchid

alt_summaries.summary: Keepers' sanctuary housing Ailith and the Genesis Tree.
Hub reached by the Horned Skull; home of the Genesis Tree and Ailith.

nodes.name: Moti Aro
nodes.summary: Karui port that Kingsmarch ships can supply; rewards vary (runegrafts at Kalguuran ports, tattoos at Karui ports).
sources: Shipping: Exclusive rewards / Table of rewards

nodes.name: Mount Veruso
nodes.summary: Mountain beneath which virtue gems were discovered by the Vaal, who used them to gain great power.

nodes.name: The Mud Flats (Act 6)
nodes.summary: Act 6 area reached from the Coast; its entrance is blocked by Hiveborn structures until the Into the Breach quest is started.
sources: Walkthrough: 'approaching the entrance to the Mud Flats from the Coast in Act 6, where the entrance is blocked off by Hiveborn structures'

nodes.name: Ngakanu
nodes.summary: Tukohama-tribe settlement under Chieftain Tavakai, reached late in Act 4; a hostile Blood Fever zone after Tavakai's declaration. Kaimana lives here.
sources: Shipping: Exclusive rewards / Table of rewards

alt_summaries.summary: Karui port that Kingsmarch ships can supply; rewards vary (runegrafts at Kalguuran ports, tattoos at Karui ports).

nodes.name: Ngamakanui
nodes.summary: Karui homeland, an archipelago southwest of Lioneye's Watch; to the Karui the name (Nga + Makanui, 'the Karui Way') denotes anywhere the Karui roam. Explorable in PoE2 Act 4, where it is overrun by the Flesh Scourge (speculative per wiki).
sources: [5:33] Kahuturoa: 'Ngamakanui isn't a place, not really.'

alt_summaries.summary: Karui homeland archipelago, seat of Kaom and Hyrri; where Voll sought Kaom's help.
Karui homeland archipelago.

The Karui 'archipelago': per Kahuturoa, not a fixed place but wherever the Karui bring their Way ('Makanui is our Way'); the Karui deliberately keep its location from the Vaal. Act 4 is set among its islands around Kingsmarch.
Karui archipelago where the weapon pieces lie.

nodes.name: Oriath
nodes.summary: Island off the south-east of Wraeclast, founded by Innocence's banished followers and ruled by the Templar theocracy from Theopolis. Unaffected by the Cataclysm, it served as the Empire's successor; destroyed in the Atlas storyline of PoE1 and revisited in PoE2 Act 4.

alt_summaries.summary: A small island off Wraeclast's south-east coast, founded by followers of Innocence. Unaffected by the Cataclysm, it became the successor of the Eternal Empire and a Templar theocracy.
Island Theocracy ruled by the Templar.
Capital of the Templar Theocracy; fallen to Kitava's cultists, revisited in Act 10 and rebuilt in the Epilogue.

Former Templar capital destroyed by Sirus in PoE1; PoE2 outsiders think it was abandoned 20 years ago, but the Twilight Order secretly rebuilt its heart and keeps the Beast here (Kanu, Act 4). Setting of the unreleased Act 5.

nodes.name: Oriath Docks
nodes.summary: Act 10 town where Lani, Weylam and Lilly Roth, Divinia and Sin base themselves.

nodes.name: Oriath Square
nodes.summary: Square leading to the Templar Courts, Ossuary and Reliquary.

nodes.name: Overseer's Tower
nodes.summary: Act 5 town, rebel camp.

nodes.name: The Pale Court
nodes.summary: Prophecy-system area where the Pale Council bosses (Eber, Inya, Yriel, Volkuur) are fought; the wiki states this content was removed in 3.17.0.
sources: Infobox location = [[The Pale Court]]; header 'The prophecy system was removed from the game in version 3.17.0'

nodes.name: Phaaryl
nodes.summary: Unexplorable location north of Sarn, said to be the point of invasion of the Harbingers as described in Commander Kirac's 'Kirac's Memory' quest dialogue. More than three thousand Oriathan soldiers were killed in the Battle of Phaaryl.
sources: lead paragraph: 'an unexplorable location north of Sarn ... the point of invasion by the Harbingers, as described by Commander Kirac's Kirac's Memory quest dialogue. Over three thousand Oriathan soldiers were killed in the Battle of Phaaryl'

nodes.name: Phrecia (imperial heartlands)
nodes.summary: Imperial heartlands of the Eternal Empire named in honour of General Alano Phrecia after he drove away a pervasive darkness; contains Phrecia Cathedral (modern Fellshrine Ruins).

nodes.name: Phrecia Cathedral
nodes.summary: Cathedral seat of Archbishop Geofri in the Phrecian heartlands (today the Fellshrine Ruins); Geofri was killed here by Maligaro.

nodes.name: Pondium
nodes.summary: Kalguuran port that Kingsmarch ships can supply; rewards vary (runegrafts at Kalguuran ports, tattoos at Karui ports).
sources: Shipping: Exclusive rewards / Table of rewards

nodes.name: Pondium (Valerie's home port)
nodes.summary: Lawless port where Valerie and Vesper grew up; Valerie says it holds more fairness than Oriath.

nodes.name: Precursor Shrine
nodes.summary: Underground shrine built around a mirror by the 'oldest of men' (probably primeval/precursor); Uhtred hid here and the Kalguuran survivors tried to reach it. No link to Kalandra's mirror is proven.

nodes.name: Precursor Towers
nodes.summary: Precursor Tower system met on the PoE2 Atlas, apparently built for terraforming Wraeclast (per Doryani's research quoted on the History page). In Legacy of the Precursors, activating a Precursor Beacon makes a Precursor Fortress rise from the ground; the Ziggurat sits over ancient 'leylines'.
sources: flavour: 'they sought to master this world'
Activate the Precursor Beacon: 'the Precursor Fortress will rise from the ground'; Doryani on leylines

nodes.name: Prisoner's Gate (Act 6)
nodes.summary: Act 6 area with the side area Valley of the Fire Drinker where Abberath is found.
sources: Located in The Valley of the Fire Drinker, side area of Prisoner's Gate

nodes.name: Riben Fell
nodes.summary: Kalguuran port that Kingsmarch ships can supply; rewards vary (runegrafts at Kalguuran ports, tattoos at Karui ports).
sources: Shipping: Exclusive rewards / Table of rewards

nodes.name: The Rogue Harbour
nodes.summary: Hub town of the criminal guild known as the Ring, reached by a Rogue's Marker portal (introduced by an Act 6 quest from 3.13.0); home of the fence Faustus, administrator Kurai, rogues and the Wayfinder Adiyah who opens contract portals.

nodes.name: Ruins of Kingsmarch
nodes.summary: Devastated Kingsmarch, hub of the Expedition storyline.

nodes.name: Sarn
nodes.summary: Capital of the Eternal Empire, founded by Veruso on the site of Azala Vaal. Burned during the Night of a Thousand Ribbons, rebuilt, besieged by Voll in 1334 IC and fallen within an hour of the Cataclysm. The Act 8 city of the exile.

alt_summaries.summary: Ruined Eternal Empire capital.
Eternal Empire capital founded on the ruins of Azala Vaal.

nodes.name: The Sarn Encampment
nodes.summary: Act 8 town amid the ruins of Sarn; home of Hargan, Clarissa and Maramoa.

alt_summaries.summary: Act 3 town in Sarn.

nodes.name: Sceptre of God
nodes.summary: Imperial palace tower of Sarn where Chitus, Malachai and Dialla held court (concubines kept there); the exile kills Dominus atop it in Act 3.

alt_summaries.summary: Tower in Sarn where Dominus's laboratory stands at the summit.

nodes.name: The Shaper's Realm
nodes.summary: Realm at the centre of the Atlas where the Shaper is fought ('the Crucible' in the legacy quest); the Uber Elder fight takes place in its version of the Absence of Value and Meaning.
sources: Assignment 11: 'found the Shaper in the Crucible'

nodes.name: The Slave Pens
nodes.summary: Arrival area in Oriath ruled by Overseer Krow.

nodes.name: Solaris Temple
nodes.summary: Sarn temple where Malachai built the Rapture Device over more than a year; the exile meets Dialla on Level 2 in Act 3.
sources: Maramoa on The Dawn and the Sun Orb

alt_summaries.summary: Temple in north-east Sarn where Lady Dialla is found.
Sarn temple holding the Sun Orb, guarded by the exile 'Dawn'.

nodes.name: Starfall Crater
nodes.summary: Area reached through an entrance that can randomly appear in ore-deposit maps; holds The Black Knight, who guards several Verisium Outcrops (Kingsmarch wiki, Bosses section).
sources: ==Bosses== ===The Black Knight===: "Map areas containing ore deposits can randomly contain an entrance to the Starfall Crater, which holds the Black Knight inside guarding several Verisium Outcrops."

nodes.name: Stridevolf
nodes.summary: Enclave on the southern outskirts of the Vastiri Plains, past Mount Vastiri. It was burned down by the unnamed 'bandit king of Stridevolf' during a conflict with the Maraketh warrior Orbala. Governor Kastov is listed among its notable members.
sources: lead paragraph: 'an enclave on the southern outskirts of the Vastiri Plains, past Mount Vastiri ... burned down by the bandit king of Stridevolf during a conflict with Maraketh warrior Orbala'; 'Notable members: Governor Kastov'. No date is given on the page, so era is unknown.

nodes.name: The Submerged Passage
nodes.summary: Flooded tidal cave in the Act 1 Mud Flats, behind the glyph wall. It is drained when the three Karui glyphs are fitted into the wall.
sources: Quest objective 'open the Submerged Passage'; 'The Submerged Passage is now open'

nodes.name: Sulphur Vents (Delve)
nodes.summary: Biome of the Azurite Mine (Delve) with Fractured, Metallic, Perfect, Aetheric and Encrusted fossils; its biome-specific nodes include Humid Fissure and Restless Rubble. Introduced in 3.4.0.
sources: Intro: 'Sulfur Vents is one of the biomes of the Azurite Mine'; Fossils list; Version history 3.4.0 'Introduced to the game'

nodes.name: Tane's Laboratory
nodes.summary: Underground laboratory of Tane Octavius near the Karui Shores, undamaged by Oriath's destruction; where Metamorph work is done.

nodes.name: Te Onui
nodes.summary: Karui port that Kingsmarch ships can supply; rewards vary (runegrafts at Kalguuran ports, tattoos at Karui ports).
sources: Shipping: Exclusive rewards / Table of rewards

nodes.name: The Templar Courts
nodes.summary: Templar stronghold built by Avarius's command; becomes Torched Courts.

nodes.name: Temple of Chaos
nodes.summary: Vaal temple near the outskirts of Utzaal where commoners could attempt the Trials of Chaos to become high priests; in PoE2 Act 3, off the Chimeral Wetlands.
sources: paragraph on the Temple of Chaos

alt_summaries.summary: Temple of Vaal priests dedicated to Chaos on the outskirts of Utzaal; site of the PoE2 Trial of Chaos.

nodes.name: The Temple of Decay
nodes.summary: Arakaali's temple in the Vaal City where Silk is lost and Arakaali is killed.
sources: Kill Arakaali at the heart of the Temple of Decay

alt_summaries.summary: Arakaali's temple, Act 7.

nodes.name: The Abyss (place)
nodes.summary: Underground realm reached through Abyss pits; Abyssal Depths.

nodes.name: The Aqueduct
nodes.summary: Act 4 area on the way to Highgate, where Lady Dialla first waits for the Exile to ask them to destroy the Beast.
sources: Walkthrough quest log: 'Dialla is waiting for you on the Aqueduct'

nodes.name: The Ascent
nodes.summary: Mt. Veruso path east of Highgate (an Act 4 area, level 40) leading to the Resonator whose portal opens to Oriath.

nodes.name: The Bath House
nodes.summary: Sarn area where Hector Titucius guards the Wings of Vastiri.

nodes.name: The Battlefront
nodes.summary: Sarn battlefront held by the Ebony Legion. A Blackguard chest here holds the Ribbon Spool, guarded by an optional boss.
sources: Walkthrough: 'Find the Ribbon Spool in the Battlefront'

nodes.name: The Beachhead
nodes.summary: The Beachhead is a map (several variants, e.g. Red tier and Infused) that holds the Harbinger Portal; defeating the final King Harbinger in any variant drops the unique Harbinger item pieces.
sources: 'Unique pieces' and 'Harbinger scroll' sections; src_poewiki_harbinger_league 'Unique items' section

nodes.name: The Belly of the Beast / Rotting Core (Act 9)
nodes.summary: Interior of the Beast's corpse; the Black Core / Rotting Core is where the Depraved Trinity is fought.

nodes.name: The Breach (realm)
nodes.summary: Parallel realm opened by breaches in which Breachlords hold domains; see concept_breach.
sources: lead: breaches open a parallel realm containing otherworldly monsters

nodes.name: The Bridge Encampment
nodes.summary: Act 7 town on the broken bridge once ruled by Kraityn, now home to Yeena, Helena, Eramir and Weylam Roth's ghost.

nodes.name: The Canals
nodes.summary: The Act 10 waterways of Oriath, behind Kitava's Horns, where Kitava feeds; Innocence opens the way to them and the Feeding Trough lies there.
sources: Walkthrough: 'Kitava, the Insatiable's Horns block the way to the The Canals where Kitava, the Insatiable feeds.'

nodes.name: The Cradle
nodes.summary: Mirror-portal realm near the Beast where Atziri, the Fell Serpent is fought in PoE2.

nodes.name: The Crematorium
nodes.summary: Slum area where Piety tortured Tolman.

nodes.name: The Desecrated Chambers
nodes.summary: Defiled Chamber of Innocence where Avarius' staff lies; Avarius, Reassembled is fought here.

nodes.name: The Dread Thicket
nodes.summary: An Act 7 area in the Northern Forest where the Fireflies needed for Yeena's Fire Dew are found.
sources: Walkthrough: 'Search for the Firefly in the The Dread Thicket (Act 7), then deliver Firefly to Yeena.'
Progression table: 'The Dread Thicket (Act 7) 53' branching from The Northern Forest (Act 7)

nodes.name: The Dried Lake
nodes.summary: Place where Voll fled after the Cataclysm and wrote his Confession; he and his undead legion remained there for centuries.

nodes.name: The Feeding Trough
nodes.summary: Final area of Act 10 where Kitava feeds and is slain.
sources: You have found Kitava at his Feeding Trough

nodes.name: The Grain Gate
nodes.summary: Sarn gate attacked by the Purity forces; failed assault repelled by Chitus' gemlings. Gemlings survive there in Act 8.

nodes.name: The Grand Arena
nodes.summary: Daresso's Dream arena modelled on Theopolis's Grand Arena.

nodes.name: The Harbour Bridge
nodes.summary: Sarn bridge with the Sky Shrine where Solaris and Lunaris are summoned and killed.
sources: Sky Shrine in the center of The Harbour Bridge

nodes.name: The Library
nodes.summary: Sarn library where Siosa dwells; Archives hide the Golden Pages.

nodes.name: The Lightless Hollow
nodes.summary: Circular arena with a central abyssal pit where Zorath lies suspended; accessible directly on the Atlas.
sources: Entry: "Zorath's arena is called The Lightless Hollow, and can be directly traversed to on the Atlas"

nodes.name: The Menagerie
nodes.summary: Act 2 location unlocked by completing Einhar's Hunt; Einhar gives the optional Einhar's Menagerie quest here (perform beastcrafting once).
sources: Rewards and 'Quest Complete - You have unlocked the Menagerie'

nodes.name: The Mines (Highgate)
nodes.summary: Mountain mines sealed by Deshret with the Beast inside.

nodes.name: The Necropolis
nodes.summary: Graveyard where haunted corpses are buried and exorcised to add crafting modifiers to the Tome of Arimor.
sources: Perform the Exorcism in The Necropolis

nodes.name: The Nightmare (Scourge realm)
nodes.summary: Ruined, demon-infested alternate version of Wraeclast the exile shifts into in Scourge; monsters there become the new Beyond monsters. Not the same as the Vaal 'crimson nightmare' realm of Atziri.

nodes.name: The Oasis
nodes.summary: Hidden oasis where Shakari rebuilds her army; she is fought in the Sand Pit.

nodes.name: The Ossuary (Act 10)
nodes.summary: Templar bone-vault in Oriath holding Atziri's Elixir of Allure (love potion in her lover's skull) and the Mortinomicon Exitio Immortalis.

alt_summaries.summary: Oriath ossuary where the Sign of Purity is found.

nodes.name: The Quarry
nodes.summary: Act 9 area with a side area for Garukhan and the blood pools around the Lesion where Sin burns a way into the Beast.

nodes.name: The Quay
nodes.summary: Sarn dockside where Clarissa's failed resurrection of Tolman takes place.

nodes.name: The Ravaged Square
nodes.summary: Oriath's square where Kitava's Horns block the way to the Canals.
sources: Horns in the Ravaged Oriath Square

nodes.name: The Reliquary
nodes.summary: Holds Kitava's Torments.

nodes.name: The Sacred Grove
nodes.summary: Ancient garden carved from the land (possibly by ancestral Azmeri, 'older than the Eternal Empire') where Oshabi plants seeds; restored her connection to the land.

nodes.name: The Sewers
nodes.summary: Filthy tunnels under the river between Sarn's districts, filled with the Undying. An Undying Blockade bars the way and is burned away with Infernal Talc.
sources: Walkthrough: 'Approach the Undying Blockade in The Sewers'

nodes.name: The Ship Graveyard
nodes.summary: Coastal wreck field where Fairgraves is marooned.

nodes.name: The Simulacrum
nodes.summary: The Simulacrum: a wave-based Delirium encounter opened by the Simulacrum map fragment in a Map Device; the fragment is crafted from Simulacrum Splinters dropped by Delirium monsters.

nodes.name: The Temple of Atzoatl
nodes.summary: Vaal temple-complex built in the last years of Atziri's reign, centre of trade, mechanical research, Chayula worship and Doryani's gem experiments; Atziri moved her seat here. PoE1 Incursion league lets players reach it 2,000 years in the past.

nodes.name: The Vaal City
nodes.summary: Vaal city risen from the depths in Act 7, accessed via the Causeway; contains Arakaali's Temple of Decay.
sources: Yeena in The Vaal City near Arakaali's temple
city has risen from the depths

alt_summaries.summary: Vaal city that rose to prominence under Queen Tetzlapokal; PoE1 Act 7 area.

nodes.name: The Weaver's Chambers
nodes.summary: Spider-infested caves entered from the Western Forest.

nodes.name: The Wetlands (Act 2)
nodes.summary: Act 2 wetland area where the great tree Lorrata has rooted itself across the entrance to the Vaal Ruins. The Exile poisons the tree with Maligaro's Spike and the Baleful Gem.
sources: Quest objective 'Poison the tree, Lorrata, in The Wetlands'

nodes.name: The Wetlands (Act 6)
nodes.summary: Act 6 area whose side area The Spawning Ground holds Ryslatha.
sources: Walkthrough: Spawning Grounds in The Wetlands

nodes.name: Theopolis
nodes.summary: Capital city of the Theocracy of Oriath; site of the Oriath academy where Valdo worked and of the Templar Laboratory.
sources: Memory of Wonder: 'a map of Theopolis'

alt_summaries.summary: Capital of Oriath and seat of the High Templar; home of the Grand Arena where Daresso fought.

nodes.name: Throne of Atziri
nodes.summary: Tier-3 incursion room of Xipocado in the Temple of Atzoatl containing a boss encounter with Atziri.

nodes.name: Trarthus
nodes.summary: Region southwest of Wraeclast and west of the Karui archipelago; capital Korathin; a brutal slave-and-killer culture ruled by four Great Houses, once the Eternal Empire's dumping ground for exiles.

alt_summaries.summary: Land south-west of Wraeclast used by the Empire as an exile colony; rebelled in 870 IC.

nodes.name: Tsoatha
nodes.summary: Ancient sunken city, domain of the Brine King; Lilly Roth wants to plunder it after his death.
sources: Lilly: 'his sunken domain, the ancient city of Tsoatha'

nodes.name: The Twilight Strand
nodes.summary: The shore where each PoE1 league's Exile washes up after the Oriathan sentence, face-down in the sand.
sources: section 'The Present' and 'The Atlas of Worlds'

alt_summaries.summary: Beach where exiles first wash ashore; ends at Lioneye's Watch.

nodes.name: Utzaal
nodes.summary: Vaal city, centre of Doryani's research, drowned by its own waterways at the Cataclysm to spite looters. PoE2 Act 3 setting: the Exile drains the Sunken City, then travels to its living past.
sources: Quest logs 'Speak to the Hooded One' / 'Enter Utzaal in the past'

alt_summaries.summary: Sunken Vaal city in the jungles of Act 3; the Hooded One sends the Exile to Utzaal to seek knowledge of the Beast. Its past version is reached through a time gateway.

nodes.name: The Vaal Ruins (PoE1 Act 2)
nodes.summary: Vaal ruin from which the Exile unleashes Darkness.

nodes.name: Vaal Temple (map)
nodes.summary: Atlas map area themed on Vaal corruption, containing ten Vaal Vessel strongboxes and the demon boss trio; tileset similar to the Apex of Sacrifice.

nodes.name: Vastiri (Plains / Desert)
nodes.summary: Region bordering Phaaryl, Lira Vaal and Sarn, home of the Maraketh; once a lush land of forests and seven rivers around Keth, it became a desert over thousands of years after the Beast silenced the gods.

alt_summaries.summary: Maraketh desert east of Highgate with the oasis shielded by Shakari's sandstorm.

nodes.name: The Well of Souls
nodes.summary: Wellspring of necromancy that collects all souls; Kulemak's seat. In PoE2 reached via the Lightless Passage from Mastodon Badlands in Act 2; later the Abyss hub.

alt_summaries.summary: Source of necromantic power that collects all souls; hub area in PoE2 Abyss content.

nodes.name: Wraeclast
nodes.summary: The continent on which the Exile's story takes place; PoE2 is set on (and expands) Wraeclast, while Oriath is another continent seen in PoE1.

alt_summaries.summary: The continent where the Exile is sent. It was the site of the Precursor, Primeval, Vaal and Eternal Empire civilisations, and the Cataclysm's effects were mostly confined to its landmass.
Forsaken continent where exiles are sent.
Continent of the Path of Exile setting.

nodes.name: Aberrations
nodes.summary: Environmental lore objects tied to the Originator (Zana) and her father Valdo. Most entries are narrated by Zana: the Atlas as a trap, Sirus's transformation by the Atlas, her intervention through memory threads to save him, and the Templars' brutality. The entries in the Incarnation boss arenas are narrated by Valdo.
sources: lead: 'environmental lore objects found in areas related to Zana, the Originator ... the ones in the Incarnation boss arenas are narrated by Valdo'; 'Entry 2 (The Success)': 'I set the threads in motion across time and space'; 'The Neglected Flame' on Sirus

nodes.name: Al-Hezmin's Journals
nodes.summary: Four clickable hunter's journals from Al-Hezmin's arena. They are notes on his companions (Baran's prayers, Veritania's reading, Zana's secrets, Drox's drills), his rivalry with Drox, and a final entry about a 'New Person' who talked with Zana and seemed stronger than the other exiles.
sources: section 'Journal I' (Baran: 'Prayer is the centre of his regimen'; Zana: 'Hiding something important') to 'Journal IV': 'New Person: I don't recognise this one ... Saw them talking to Zana.'

nodes.name: Ancient Etchings (Kalandra)
nodes.summary: Series of Ancient Etchings in the Lake of Kalandra written by Kalandra herself, recounting her entrapment, scorn for gods (Etching V: a conversation with someone implied to be Sin), and the Order of the Djinn's failed rescue (Etching VI).
sources: Prehistory > The Lake of Kalandra footnotes
Ancient Etchings entry (found throughout the Lake)

alt_summaries.summary: Series of etchings in the Lake of Kalandra written by Kalandra: her entry, view of gods as 'thieves of virtue', a conversation with a 'little thief' (Sin), the Order of the Djinn's abandoned promise, and a new escape plan.

nodes.name: Baran's Journals
nodes.summary: Four clickable journals from Baran's arena: a will bequeathing his staff and platemail to Veritania, Sirus, Drox and Al-Hezmin and his Oriathan home to Templar siblings; a letter to Landren about being trapped in the Atlas; a letter to a discoverer describing the demon that fed on Valdo Caeserius's memories ('the Decay') and Sirus's sacrifice; and a final entry in which Baran turns to God and plans to take the Atlas.
sources: section 'Journal I' (Last Will and Testament: 'To my good friends and allies, Veritania, Sirus, Drox, and Al-Hezmin'), 'Journal III' ('feeding on the memories of Valdo Caeserius'), 'Journal IV' ('I am your sword')

nodes.name: Journals of the Conquerors
nodes.summary: Lore objects in the Conquerors' arenas (added 3.9.2) narrating each Elderslayer's descent.

nodes.name: Drox's Journals
nodes.summary: Four clickable journals in Drox's arena in which the former exile pursues a kingdom of law and justice through force, conquers valley after valley and grows more convinced that strength will make the mists real, ending as 'Drox the Warlord'.
sources: section 'Journal I' ('Drox the Just') to 'Journal IV' ('Drox the Warlord.'); Journal I: 'I shall be the one who leads')

nodes.name: Emperor's Warning
nodes.summary: Notice at The Prisoner's arena: 'By the order of Emperor Izaro... The prisoner within is beyond death.' signed Emperor Chitus Perandus.

nodes.name: Feverish Writings (Niko)
nodes.summary: Letter by Niko ('Your master, Niko') in the Doomed Mine on the Isle of Kin, urging miners to gather sulphite while a blind beast whispers in the dark. Continues PoE1's Niko (Delve) into PoE2.

nodes.name: Letter (Kingsmarch environmental lore)
nodes.summary: Rotating letters in the Kingsmarch tavern by Johan, Raulf, Sonja, Dannig, Rog, Tujen, Gwennen, Faustus and Isla revealing their secret rebel ties, loves and loyalties.

nodes.name: Letters from Chitus
nodes.summary: Three letters from Chitus to Cadiro (1316-1318 IC) planning to win Izaro's Labyrinth. Released as physical GGG merchandise.

nodes.name: Letters of Exile
nodes.summary: Environmental lore object in Lioneye's Watch: court papers nailed to stakes that give the sentences of named exiles (1597-1599 IC) in the formula 'You are hereby Exiled to Wraeclast where, it is hoped, you shall come to repent your Sins'. Added in version 0.10.8. Distinct from text_letters_from_chitus (Chitus's letters to Cadiro) and text_vaal_letters (Vaal victims' letters).
sources: intro: 'Letters of Exile is an environmental lore object found in Lioneye's Watch.'; section '==Format==' sentencing formula; version history 0.10.8

nodes.name: Lifegiver's Manifesto
nodes.summary: Catarina's writings in Syndicate hideouts urging an immortal new world order and herself as eternal queen.

nodes.name: The Lord's Labyrinth (gamebook)
nodes.summary: An official GGG gamebook (2019) that retells the Lord's Labyrinth from Weylin's perspective. The PoE Wiki reports repeated inconsistencies with in-game sources, so it is generally not treated as canon.
sources: gamebook forum post, 28 Oct 2019 (cited in History of Wraeclast, 'The Lord's Labyrinth')
section 'The Lord's Labyrinth' (gamebook note: generally not canon)

nodes.name: Lycia's relics
nodes.summary: Forbidden Sanctum relics revealing the Original Sin and Innocence's ascension.

nodes.name: Path of Exile: Origins
nodes.summary: Official comic recounting Victario, the Karui Way, the Chamber of Sins and Chitus' death.

nodes.name: Path of Exile: Origins (comic)
nodes.summary: A four-issue official comic by Grinding Gear Games and Dynamite Entertainment, told from Victario's perspective. Digital issues ran from July 2014 to April 2015; the paperback was published by Dynamite in June 2015. It centres on the Purity Rebellion and events leading up to the Cataclysm.
sources: 'Publication' section (issue table) and intro: written by Edwin McRae and Royal McGraw, illustrated by Carlos Rodriguez

nodes.name: Precursor Edicts
nodes.summary: Vague Precursor murals depicting the Beast (or a precursor of it) and possibly instructions for containing it. The corpus separately says Sin later created the Beast from a Precursor Seed of Corruption; any reading that the Beast predates the gods is interpretation.

nodes.name: The Purity Chronicles
nodes.summary: Six-book chronicle by Garivaldi in the Library of Sarn (Act 3 area) on the Purity Rebellion.

nodes.name: Memory Fragments of the Shaper
nodes.summary: Seven in-game diary entries (Home, Intrigue, Wonder, Dream, Nightmare, Grief, Awakening) in which Valdo describes the golden device, dreams, Zana's capture and resolving to 'forge a world anew'. Partly superseded by the Book of Memories retcon.

nodes.name: Sirus' Journals
nodes.summary: Four clickable lore journals in the Conquerors of the Atlas boss rooms that expand the story of Sirus, Awakener of Worlds: his wish for purpose, his dread of the monster the group pursues, the last days with his companions, and his entrapment and 'empty' existence after he stepped into an orb of darkness.
sources: section 'Journal 1' ('If it weren't for Zana...') to 'Journal 4' ('They left me. In my moment of need, they left me.' ... 'Empty.')

nodes.name: Chamber of Innocence stained glass windows
nodes.summary: Templar propaganda in Oriath depicting Innocence as pure and Sin as deceitful twin; later contradicted by Lycia.

nodes.name: The Ancients (Trinian)
nodes.summary: In-game history by Trinian in the Library of Sarn (PoE1 Act 3), Books 1-5 on Atziri, Zerphi, Doryani, the Azmeri and the Fall.

nodes.name: Architects' notes in Atziri's Temple
nodes.summary: Environmental texts in Atziri's Temple: 'The Perfect Design' (Architect's living-machine temple, expecting Doryani's proxies to try to stop 'Atziri's Ascension'), 'Disloyalty' (an Architect suspects Doryani is moving against the Queen over the Red Communion) and 'The Forever Queen' (Atziri names a critic her personal Architect).

nodes.name: Vaal Letters
nodes.summary: Twelve readable letters by victims and subjects of Atziri's regime, documenting sacrifice and dissent.

nodes.name: Veritania's Journals
nodes.summary: Four clickable journal entries that appeared in Veritania's arena after she was defeated. They trace her from a self-described disciplined exile who is disgusted by Atlas vice, to the self-appointed 'Redeemer' who plans to purge the mortals who indulge.
sources: section 'Journal I' to 'Journal IV': e.g. Journal III 'I am the only one that can save us', signed 'Veritania the Pure'; Journal IV 'I shall save you from your own vices by purging your weakness.' signed 'Veritania the Redeemer'

nodes.name: Victario's Writings
nodes.summary: Four environmental lore texts in The Library, written as anecdotes and allegory by the poet Victario of Sarn: Kalisa Maas and the Virtue gem that shatters glass; the Blackest Monkey parable; Slaves of Virtue, on shackled workers who mine gems for the Eternal citizens while Malachai abuses them; and A Friend in Need, on the musician Lorenzi who has a gem implanted in his hand.
sources: section headings 'Volume 1: Kalisa Maas', 'Volume 2: The Blackest Monkey', 'Volume 3: Slaves of Virtue' (mentions Malachai and Highgate), 'Volume 4: A Friend in Need' (Lorenzi and Malachai's gem implant); each signed 'Victario of Sarn'

nodes.name: Voll's Confession
nodes.summary: Voll's confession that he trusted the most corrupt of men.

nodes.name: The Word of the Dreamer
nodes.summary: Environmental-lore book in the Monastery of the Keepers written by Ailith recording five visions of the Dreamer. Four visions warn of the Mother (births flesh), the Red Pyre (flame/addiction), the Forked Psyche (thought without will) and the Preserved Patterns (imprisoned bodies), each of whom the Dreamer 'once knew'; the fifth says the Four have become One and that the Genesis Tree is his gift. The mapping of these four to Uul-Netol (flesh), Xoph (fire), Esh (forked thought) and Tul (preserved/frozen) is inference from epithets and the wiki's note that the book is about the four Breachlords that became Xesht.

edges.description: High Templar Dominus orders the criminals of Oriath exiled to Wraeclast.
The Templar theocracy of Oriath carries out the sentence of exile.
The sentencing takes place in Oriath, before the exiles are shipped to Wraeclast.
A Dying Exile on the Twilight Strand describes the two dozen exiles dumped from the ship and points the Exile towards the smoke.
sources: Walkthrough: Dying Exile quote "We're all that made it? They dumped... two dozen of us exiles off that ship"

edges.description: Dominus's Blackguards are the ones who dumped the exiles into the water.
sources: Walkthrough: Tarkleigh quote "[Dominus's] Blackguards dumped us in the water out there"

edges.description: Hillock, the Blacksmith, is the boss the Exile kills outside Lioneye's Watch.
sources: Quest infobox boss=Hillock; objective 'Kill Hillock. He is outside the town.'

edges.description: Tarkleigh gives the Exile the reward for killing Hillock.
sources: Quest infobox completion=Talk to Tarkleigh; Walkthrough 'Talk to Tarkleigh for your reward'

edges.description: The Dying Exile on the beach sends the Exile up the beach, where the quest begins.
sources: Walkthrough: '(Optional) Talk to the nearby Dying Exile ... there may be people further up the beach'

edges.description: The three glyphs are fitted into the glyph wall in the Mud Flats, opening the Submerged Passage.
sources: Quest infobox objective 'open the Submerged Passage'; Walkthrough 'The Submerged Passage is now open'

edges.description: Tarkleigh identifies the Karui glyph shells and tells the Exile where to fit them.
sources: Walkthrough: Tarkleigh dialogue 'complete the set, fit them into the sockets, and stand well back'

edges.description: Brutus, Warden of Axiom Prison, is the boss fought in the Warden's Chambers.
sources: Quest infobox boss=Brutus, Lord Incarcerator; objective 'Kill Brutus in the Warden's Chambers'

edges.description: Tarkleigh starts the quest and briefs the Exile on Brutus.
sources: Quest infobox start=Talk to Tarkleigh; Walkthrough Tarkleigh dialogue

edges.description: Nessa tells the Exile the history of Brutus as Warden of Axiom Prison.
sources: Walkthrough: Nessa dialogue 'The tale of Brutus was a popular one in the schools of Theopolis'

edges.description: The Caged Brute is fought in the Warden's Chambers of Axiom Prison.
sources: Objective: 'Kill Brutus in the Warden's Chambers in the Upper Prison'

edges.description: Merveil, the Siren, is the boss the Exile kills in her lair.
sources: Quest infobox boss=Merveil, the Siren; objective 'Kill Merveil, in her lair'

edges.description: Nessa starts the quest and warns the Exile about Merveil.
The fight with Merveil takes place in her lair at the head of Siren's Cove.
sources: Objective 'Kill Merveil, in her lair'; completion 'Enter the Forest' from her lair

edges.description: The Exile arrives at the Forest Encampment, the village in the Southern Forest.
sources: Act 2 walkthrough: The Forest Encampment is the town of Act 2

edges.description: Greust, the Forest Encampment's weapon and armour vendor, is present in the village; he is the quest giver of Intruders in Black. The 'leader' wording was not supported by the cited page.
sources: Walkthrough: Greust dialogue 'Nothing like this... Bring back the light' (Greust leads the encampment)

edges.description: Silk is one of the Forest Encampment villagers, and gives out the Sharp and Cruel quest.
sources: Walkthrough intro: quest 'given by Silk in Forest Encampment'

edges.description: Yeena, a Forest Encampment resident, dreams of the shadow and is the quest source.
sources: Quest walkthrough: 'talk to Yeena in the Forest Encampment to receive this quest'

edges.description: Eramir, a Forest Encampment resident, gives the Exile the bandit contract and its reward.
sources: Quest infobox start=Talk to Eramir; Quest text 'Eramir and the Forest Encampment'

edges.description: Greust sends the Exile east to investigate the warriors in black.
sources: Quest infobox start=Talk to Greust; Walkthrough Greust dialogue 'Go east and find these warriors in black'

edges.description: Fidelitas, the Mourning, is the boss the Exile kills in the Chamber of Sins.
sources: Quest infobox boss=Fidelitas, the Mourning; objective 'Kill Fidelitas'

edges.description: Helena is the girl the Exile rescues from Fidelitas and then brings into the encampment.
sources: Walkthrough: Helena dialogue 'Help me!' and 'Meet Helena in town'

edges.description: Greust's quest describes the warriors in black as Blackguards searching the Chamber of Sins. The page's Trivia says Act 2 Blackguards actually appear in the Western Forest, so the link is only medium confidence.
sources: Walkthrough: Helena dialogue 'My days with the Ebony Legion are done!'

edges.description: The Blackguards are investigated and fought inside the Chamber of Sins.
sources: Objective: 'Investigate the Blackguards in the Chamber of Sins'

edges.description: Silk asks the Exile to retrieve his spear from the Weaver and rewards the Exile for it.
sources: Quest infobox start=Talk to Silk; Walkthrough Silk dialogue 'my best spear still in mother's eye'

edges.description: The Weaver, a giant spider, is killed to recover Maligaro's Spike.
sources: Quest infobox boss=The Weaver; objective 'Kill The Weaver'

edges.description: The Weaver is killed in the Weaver's Chambers, reached from the Western Forest.
sources: Walkthrough: 'venture into The Weaver's Chambers (entrance located in The Western Forest)'

edges.description: The quest is started and resolved in the Forest Encampment, where Silk lives.
sources: Walkthrough: quest given by Silk in Forest Encampment; reward on return 'Talk to Silk'

edges.description: Kraityn is one of the three bandit lords who terrorise the Forest Encampment.
Alira is one of the three bandit lords; she can be killed or spared.
Oak is one of the three bandit lords; he can be killed or spared.
Eramir gives the bandit quest and the reward for killing or sparing the bandit lords.
sources: Quest infobox start=Talk to Eramir; reward table 'Eramir'

edges.description: The three bandit lords (Alira, Oak, Kraityn) are the Bandit Lords faction.
The bandit lords terrorise the Forest Encampment, and the choice is made there.
sources: Lead: bandit leaders 'terrorizing The Forest Encampment'

edges.description: Helena gives the Exile the poison plan to open the Vaal Ruins before Piety.
sources: Quest infobox start='Talk to Helena in Forest Encampment'; Walkthrough Helena dialogue

edges.description: The great tree Lorrata is poisoned in the Wetlands.
sources: Quest infobox objective 'Poison the tree, Lorrata'; Walkthrough 'poison the tree, Lorrata, in The Wetlands'

edges.description: The quest is completed on reaching the Vaal Ruins through the cleared roots.
sources: Quest infobox completion='You have reached The Vaal Ruins'

edges.description: The Vaal Oversoul is the boss the Exile kills at the top of the Ancient Pyramid.
sources: Quest infobox boss=Vaal Oversoul; objective 'Kill the Vaal Oversoul'

edges.description: Yeena dreams of the shadow and gives the Exile the quest to send it home.
sources: Quest infobox start=Talk to Yeena; Walkthrough Yeena dialogue 'I dreamed this'

edges.description: Eramir blames the Exile for the darkness that follows the touching of the Ancient Seal.
sources: Quest walkthrough: Eramir dialogue 'you’ve caused this. Now we all suffer your consequences'

edges.description: Touching the Ancient Seal in the Vaal Ruins releases the darkness.
sources: Walkthrough: 'Once you touch the Ancient Seal in the Vaal Ruins, you will initiate this quest'

edges.description: The Exile enters the ruined capital Sarn, overrun by the undead.
sources: Walkthrough: Tolman and Clarissa 'went missing in Sarn Slums' in the City of Sarn

edges.description: The Exile reaches the Sarn Encampment, the survivors' camp.
sources: Walkthrough: quest 'given to you by Maramoa upon arriving in Sarn Encampment'

edges.description: Hargan, the Sarn Encampment's weapon and armour vendor, is present in the encampment when the Exile arrives. 'Survivor' wording was not supported by the cited page.
sources: Act 3 vendor list: 'Hargan - weapon (except wands) and armour vendor'

edges.description: Maramoa greets the Exile at the Sarn Encampment and gives the Lost in Love quest.
sources: Walkthrough: quest 'given to you by Maramoa upon arriving in Sarn Encampment'

edges.description: Grigor is a poet-scholar of the Sarn Encampment.
sources: Quest walkthrough: quest 'given to the player by Grigor in The Sarn Encampment'

edges.description: Maramoa gives the Exile the quest to find Clarissa and Tolman.
sources: Walkthrough: 'This Quest is given to you by Maramoa upon arriving in Sarn Encampment'

edges.description: Clarissa is rescued from the Blackguards in Sarn and sends the Exile after Tolman.
sources: Quest infobox start 'Meeting Clarissa in City of Sarn'; objective 'Rescue Clarissa and Tolman'

edges.description: Tolman was dragged off by Piety's henchmen and is found dead in the Crematorium.
sources: Quest infobox key_item=Tolman's Bracelet; Walkthrough 'take his bracelet' at the Crematorium

edges.description: Piety is the boss at the Crematorium and flees after losing half her health.
sources: Quest infobox boss=Piety of Theopolis; Walkthrough 'Piety (who flees after losing half of her health)'

edges.description: A full team of Blackguards guards the Crematorium and Clarissa's captors.
sources: Walkthrough: 'fighting off a full team of blackguards and Piety'

edges.description: Tolman's body and bracelet are found at the end of the Crematorium.
sources: Walkthrough: 'the Crematorium ... at the end ... Tolman's body and take his bracelet'

edges.description: Clarissa is rescued from the Blackguards in the City of Sarn.
sources: Walkthrough: Clarissa rescued from Blackguards 'in City of Sarn'

edges.description: Grigor sends the Exile to the Gemling Queen with the ode 'Of Jewels and Eternity'.
sources: Quest infobox start=Talk to Grigor; Walkthrough Grigor's ode

edges.description: Lady Dialla, the Gemling Queen, is found in the tomb on Level 2 of the Solaris Temple.
sources: Quest walkthrough: find 'Lady Dialla, the Gemling Queen'; completion 'Talk to Lady Dialla'

edges.description: The Gemling Queen's tomb is in the Solaris Temple, Level 2.
sources: Walkthrough: 'Travel to The Solaris Temple Level 2 and find Lady Dialla'

edges.description: Dialla asks the Exile to recover her Ribbon Spool, which was stolen by the black cockroaches.
sources: Quest infobox start=Talk to Lady Dialla; Dialla's lore quote on the stolen Ribbon Spool

edges.description: The Ebony Legion holds the stolen Ribbon Spool.
sources: Quest log quote: 'The Ebony Legion has stolen the Ribbon Spool.'

edges.description: The Ribbon Spool is recovered from a Blackguard chest in the Battlefront.
sources: Walkthrough: 'Find the Ribbon Spool in the Battlefront ... guarded by Captain Aurelianus'

edges.description: Dialla sends the Exile to fetch Thaumetic Sulphite so she can brew Infernal Talc.
sources: Quest infobox start=Talk to Lady Dialla; Dialla's dialogue on Thaumetic Sulphite and Infernal Talc

edges.description: The Undying Blockade blocks the Sewers and is burned away with Infernal Talc.
sources: Walkthrough: 'Approach the Undying Blockade in The Sewers'

edges.description: Grigor sends the Exile to kill Piety in her laboratory.
sources: Quest infobox start=Talk to Grigor; walkthrough 'given ... by Grigor in The Sarn Encampment'

edges.description: Piety is the boss the Exile kills in her Lunaris Temple laboratory.
Piety's laboratory in the Lunaris Temple is where she is killed.
sources: Walkthrough: 'Find Piety in her laboratory in The Lunaris Temple Level 2 and kill her'

edges.description: Dominus is the boss at the summit of the Sceptre of God.
Lady Dialla is the one who completes the quest and opens the way to Act 4.
sources: Quest infobox completion='Talk to Lady Dialla'

edges.description: Grigor can start the quest by describing the Sceptre of God and Dominus's laboratory.
sources: Walkthrough: 'Alternatively, talk to Grigor before picking up the key to start the quest'

edges.description: Most of the quest events happen in the Sceptre of God, the tower in Sarn.
sources: Lead: 'Most of the quest events are located in The Sceptre of God'

edges.description: Highgate is an encampment held by the Maraketh, where Dialla waits.
sources: Walkthrough quest log: 'You have reached Highgate, an encampment occupied by the Maraketh'

edges.description: Dialla first meets the Exile on the Aqueduct before the way to Highgate.
sources: Walkthrough quest log: 'Dialla is waiting for you on the Aqueduct'

edges.description: Dialla asks the Exile to destroy the Beast sealed in the mountain.
sources: Walkthrough quest log: 'Dialla is waiting for you on the Aqueduct. Talk to her'

edges.description: Oyun, the Maraketh akhara leader, gives advice on the darkness in the mountain.
sources: Walkthrough quest log: 'Talk to Oyun for advice'

edges.description: The Maraketh hold Highgate.
sources: Walkthrough quest log: 'an encampment occupied by the Maraketh'

edges.description: Voll, the Brittle Emperor, is the boss the Exile kills in the Dried Lake.
sources: Quest infobox boss=Voll, Emperor of Purity; objective 'Kill Voll'

edges.description: Oyun sends the Exile to take Deshret's Banner from Voll.
sources: Quest infobox start=Talk to Oyun; Oyun dialogue 'Bring Deshret's Banner home'

edges.description: Voll and Deshret's Banner are found in the Dried Lake.
sources: Walkthrough: 'Find Deshret's Banner in the Dried Lake'

edges.description: The Mines are opened by breaking Deshret's Seal in Highgate.
sources: Walkthrough: 'use it in town to break Deshret's Seal and gain access to the Mines'

edges.description: King Kaom is the boss who holds the Eye of Fury.
sources: Quest infobox boss=King Kaom; Walkthrough 'Kill him and deliver the Eye to Dialla'

edges.description: Dialla receives the Eye of Fury for the Rapture Device.
sources: Quest infobox completion='Delivered the Eye of Fury to Lady Dialla'

edges.description: The quest starts in the Crystal Veins, where the Rapture Device is.
Daresso, King of Swords, is the boss who holds the Eye of Desire.
sources: Quest infobox boss=Daresso, King of Swords; 'Kill him and deliver the Eye to Dialla'

edges.description: Dialla receives the Eye of Desire for the Rapture Device.
sources: Quest infobox completion='Delivered the Eye of Desire to Lady Dialla'

edges.description: Daresso is killed at the end of the Grand Arena.
sources: Walkthrough: 'The boss arena ... is located at the very end of The Grand Arena'

edges.description: Dialla's life force powers the Rapture Device.
sources: Lead: device 'requires ... Lady Dialla's life force to activate it'

edges.description: Malachai built the Rapture Device and then entered the Beast through the hole it made.
sources: Lead: 'Malachai ... promised ... Emperor Voll ... a device'; Malachai 'took advantage ... entered the Beast'

edges.description: The Rapture Device is located in the Crystal Veins.
sources: Lead: 'a mysterious machine, located in the Crystal Veins'

edges.description: The device drills a hole into the Belly of the Beast.
sources: Lead: 'It can drill a hole into the Beast, allowing entry into its bowels'

edges.description: Piety sets the task of gathering Malachai's organs to open the Black Core.
sources: Quest infobox start=Talk to Piety; Walkthrough 'Piety requires three of Malachai's organs'

edges.description: Shavronne of Umbra is one of the Godless Three who must be fought to obtain Malachai's organs.
Maligaro, The Inquisitor, is one of the Godless Three who must be fought for Malachai's organs.
Doedre Darktongue is one of the Godless Three who must be fought for Malachai's organs.

The Corpus Malachus page gives no location. Per the Eternal Nightmare page the organ task is done in The Harvest, and Piety says Malachai sits in the Beast's Black Core, so the Beast is the closest existing node. The Harvest is not a separate node yet.
sources: Quote (Piety): 'Venture deeper ... You find me those organs and I'll get us into the Black Core'

edges.description: Malachai, The Nightmare, is the final boss of Act 4, fought in the Black Core.
sources: Quest infobox boss=Malachai, The Nightmare; objective 'Kill Malachai'

edges.description: Piety helps the Exile break Malachai's shield and is turned into an Abomination during the fight.
sources: Fight description: 'Piety helps the player by disabling his shield'; transforms into 'Piety, the Abomination'

edges.description: Malachai is fought in the Beast's Black Core.
sources: Quote: 'Malachai is in the Beast's black core right now'

edges.description: Overseer Krow is the boss at the end of the Slave Pens maze.
sources: Walkthrough: 'the boss of this area, Overseer Krow, has to be killed'

edges.description: Lani leads the rebel encampment at Overseer's Tower and rewards the Exile.
sources: Quest completion: 'reached the rebel encampment at Overseer's Tower. Talk to Lani for a reward'

edges.description: The Exile climbs the Ascent of Mt. Veruso and activates the Resonator there.
sources: Walkthrough: 'enter The Ascent ... use the machine to open a portal to Oriath'

edges.description: The portal drops the Exile into the Slave Pens of Oriath.
The rebel camp at Overseer's Tower is the goal of the Slave Pens maze.
sources: Quest completion: 'Enter the Overseer's Tower and talk to Lani'

edges.description: Justicar Casticus is the boss in the Control Blocks whose Eyes of Zeal open the Templar Courts.
sources: Quest log quote: 'help the rebellion and kill Justicar Casticus ... in the Control Blocks'

edges.description: Casticus is killed in the Control Blocks.
sources: Walkthrough: 'go straight to The Control Blocks and kill the boss'

edges.description: The quest is granted in Overseer's Tower and the entrance to the Control Blocks is there.
sources: Walkthrough: 'This quest is granted by an NPC in the Overseer's Tower'

edges.description: High Templar Avarius is the boss slain in the Chamber of Innocence.
sources: Quest log quote: 'slay High Templar Avarius ... in the Chamber of Innocence'

edges.description: Avarius is slain in the Chamber of Innocence, after the Templar Courts are opened.
sources: Quest log quote: 'in the Chamber of Innocence'

edges.description: The Templar Courts must be entered with Casticus's Eyes before Avarius is reached.
sources: Quest log quote: 'gain access to the Templar Courts and from there, slay Avarius'

edges.description: Utula, high priest of Kitava, is the boss the Exile must kill to stop the ritual.
sources: Quest walkthrough: 'Kill Utula to prevent him from completing the King's Feast ritual'

edges.description: Bannon asks the Exile to stop Utula.
sources: Walkthrough Bannon dialogue: 'Please, find Utula and stop him'

edges.description: Utula's ritual summons Kitava, the Ravenous God.
sources: Walkthrough: 'Utula has used the fall of Innocence to summon Kitava'

edges.description: Utula is found in the Ruined Square, which is Oriath Square.
sources: Lead: Utula is on 'the Ruined Square' (Oriath Square)

edges.description: Kitava, the Ravenous God, reawakens and cannot be defeated in this act.
sources: Walkthrough: 'Kitava has awakened and is destroying Oriath ... to defeat Kitava'

edges.description: Captain Lilly Roth takes the Exile on board the ship back to Wraeclast.
sources: Quest walkthrough: 'Captain Lilly Roth ... we sail... for Wraeclast'

edges.description: The Sign of Purity is found inside the Ossuary.
sources: Walkthrough: 'find the entrance to the Ossuary ... find the Sign of Purity and use it to defeat Kitava'

edges.description: The Exile travels back through the Templar Courts to Oriath Square on the way to Kitava.
The exile arrives back in Wraeclast at Lioneye's Watch, the Act 6 town.
sources: Intro: 'its town is Lioneye's Watch'; Progression table starts at Lioneye's Watch

edges.description: Lilly Roth, first met on the Cathedral Rooftop at the end of Act 5, offers the exile a lift to Lioneye's Watch at the start of Act 6.
sources: Intro: 'She then offers a lift to Lioneye's Watch in Act 6'

edges.description: Sin, the exile's divine guide, sets the task of harvesting souls for the Dark Ember at the start of Act 6.
sources: Walkthrough, opening Sin dialogue: 'How do we obtain this Dark Ember? ... All I need are three fine souls'

edges.description: The exile enters the Karui Fortress and Tukohama's Keep to reach and kill Tukohama.
sources: Walkthrough: 'Find the exit to the the Karui Fortress... Tukohama's Keep, in the middle of the map'

edges.description: Tarkleigh points the exile to the Karui Fortress through the Eye of Conquest and rewards the kill of Tukohama.
sources: Walkthrough, Tarkleigh: 'I'd see about putting that eye back where it belongs' and 'You've killed the Karui war god?'

edges.description: The exile enters Axiom Prison and kills Shavronne's spirit in her tower there.
sources: Walkthrough: 'Sin wants you to find the spirit of Shavronne of Umbra in her tower in the Prison and kill her.'

edges.description: Sin harvests Shavronne's soul for the Dark Ember once she is killed.
sources: Walkthrough: 'You have killed Shavronne and Sin has harvested her soul.'

edges.description: The exile fights Abberath, the Cloven One, at Prisoner's Gate.
sources: Walkthrough: 'Bestel has asked you to defeat Abberath, the Cloven God, at Prisoner's Gate.'

edges.description: Bestel asks the exile to kill Abberath and rewards the kill with a passive skill point.
sources: Quest infobox start 'Talk to Bestel'; Walkthrough: 'Bestel has asked you to defeat Abberath'

edges.description: The exile reaches the Brine King's Reef on the Black Crest and fights the Brine King there.
sources: Walkthrough: 'After arriving at the Brine King's Reef, search for Nessa... After finding Nessa in The Brine King's Reef you have to defeat the boss.'

edges.description: Nessa, cursed into a mermaid by the Brine King, is freed at the reef and calls the exile her new sister.
sources: Walkthrough, Nessa at the reef: 'So courageous, such a fine example of womanhood... Thank you, my new sister.'

edges.description: Weylam Roth summons from the Black Flag and sails the exile on the Black Crest to the Brine King's reef.
sources: Walkthrough, Weylam Roth at the Beacon: 'Of course I'll ferry you to the Brine King's blood reef.'

edges.description: Tarkleigh starts the quest by sending the exile to find the missing Nessa.
sources: Quest infobox start 'Speak to Tarkleigh'; Walkthrough: 'Nessa... Please, find Nessa. Bring her back to us.'

edges.description: Sin appears after the Brine King is defeated.
sources: Walkthrough: 'After defeating The Brine King Sin will appear'

edges.description: The exile enters Maligaro's Sanctum through portals opened with his Map and kills him there.
sources: Walkthrough: 'You have opened the portals using his Map, now enter Maligaro's Sanctum.'

edges.description: Sin harvests Maligaro's soul after he is killed.
sources: Walkthrough: 'You have killed Maligaro and Sin has harvested his soul.'

edges.description: The exile kills Black Death and Maligaro in the Sanctum to take the Black Venom.
sources: Walkthrough: 'Search for it in Maligaro's Sanctum' / 'Kill it and Maligaro to obtain some Black Venom.'

edges.description: The Black Venom is delivered to Silk in the Chamber of Sins Level 1.
sources: Walkthrough: 'Deliver the Black Venom to Silk in the The Chamber of Sins Level 1 (Act 7)'

edges.description: Silk asks the exile to take the Black Venom and rewards the delivery with the Obsidian key.
sources: Quest infobox start 'Talk to Silk in Act 7'; Silk: 'Please, will you find him, kill this Black Death, take the eight-leg's venom for me?'

edges.description: Maligaro is killed together with his pet spider Black Death in the Web of Secrets quest.
sources: Quest infobox: 'boss1=Maligaro, the Artist', 'boss2=Black Death, Pain Unending'

edges.description: The exile kills the possessed Greust in the Forest Encampment to drive Ralakesh back into the relic.
sources: Walkthrough: 'Ralakesh is located in The Forest Encampment which connects The Ashen Fields and The Northern Forest.'

edges.description: Greust, possessed by Ralakesh as its avatar, is the enemy the exile must kill.
sources: Walkthrough: 'Ralakesh ... has possessed Greust... You must kill Greust to defeat Ralakesh.'

edges.description: Eramir starts the quest, translating the relic's inscriptions and urging the exile to destroy the god.
sources: Quest infobox start 'Talk to Eramir in the The Bridge Encampment'; Eramir: 'Please, I urge you to destroy this god'

edges.description: The exile gathers the seven Fireflies in the Dread Thicket.
sources: Walkthrough: 'Search for the Firefly in the The Dread Thicket (Act 7)'

edges.description: The Fireflies are delivered to Yeena in the Vaal City, at the entrance to Arakaali's temple.
sources: Walkthrough: 'Getting to Yeena from the The Dread Thicket... Yeena is located inside The Vaal City'

edges.description: Yeena asks for seven Fireflies to brew Fire Dew and burn open Arakaali's temple.
sources: Walkthrough, Yeena: 'Yeena needs seven Firefly to burn open the entrance to Arakaali, Spinner of Shadows temple.'

edges.description: The exile burns through the webs and kills Arakaali at the heart of the Temple of Decay, failing to save Silk.
sources: Walkthrough: 'Kill Arakaali at the heart of the Temple of Decay to save Silk.'

edges.description: Silk is consorting with Arakaali and is lost when she is killed.
sources: Silk: 'My bride has arrived, exile!'; log: 'You have killed Arakaali and gained access to Act 8, but failed to save Silk.'

edges.description: Yeena, who brewed the Fire Dew, accompanies the exile to Arakaali's temple.
sources: Yeena: 'Now I must return to Broken Bridge... We will speak more of Silk and sorrow then.' and Walkthrough: Yeena's warning about Silk and Arakaali

edges.description: The exile kills Doedre in the Cauldron boss arena of Doedre's Cesspool.
sources: Walkthrough: 'In the Toxic Conduits, you will find an area called Doedre's Cesspool... This is the boss arena.'

edges.description: Sin wants Doedre killed so he can harvest her soul and does so after her death.
sources: Walkthrough: 'After defeating Doedre the Vile, Sin harvests her soul.'

edges.description: Hargan tells the exile where Doedre hides in the Toxic Conduits and gives the reward.
sources: Walkthrough: 'If you speak with Hargan, he tells you that Doedre can be found somewhere in the Toxic Conduits.'

edges.description: The exile searches the Lunaris Temple for the Moon Orb carried by Dusk.
sources: Walkthrough: 'Search the The Lunaris Temple Level 2 (Act 8) for the Moon Orb'

edges.description: Maramoa sends the exile through the Sarn sewers to recover the Moon Orb.
Dusk, an exile devotee of Lunaris, carried the Moon Orb into the Lunaris Temple and keeps it from the exile.
sources: Quest infobox: 'boss=Dusk, Harbinger of Lunaris'; objective: 'KIll Dusk, Harbinger of Lunaris and take the Moon Orb'

edges.description: The exile searches the Solaris Temple for the Sun Orb guarded by Dawn.
sources: Walkthrough: 'Search the The Solaris Temple Level 1 for the Sun Orb'

edges.description: Maramoa sends the exile through the Sarn sewers to recover the Sun Orb.
Dawn, an exile devotee of Solaris, guards the Sun Orb in her temple.
sources: Quest infobox: 'boss=Dawn, Harbinger of Solaris'; Maramoa: 'The Sun Orb lies within her temple, guarded by her most ardent devotee... 'The Dawn'.'

edges.description: With both orbs, the exile summons Solaris and Lunaris in the Sky Shrine on the Harbour Bridge and kills them.
sources: Intro: 'They can be found in the Sky Shrine in the center of The Harbour Bridge once the Moon Orb and Sun Orb have been retrieved'

edges.description: Sin speaks after the twin goddesses fall, declaring the sun and moon back in their rightful places.
sources: Completion dialogue, Sin: 'Sun and Moon return to their rightful places, leaving our path now clear.'

edges.description: The exile meets Sin at the Quarry, where he burns open the way into the Beast.
sources: Walkthrough: 'Meet Sin at the The Quarry, where he will burn open a new entrance into the The Belly of the Beast (Act 9).'

edges.description: The quest's boss fight against the Depraved Trinity takes place in the Rotting Core inside the Beast.
sources: Walkthrough: 'Talk to Sin to manifest the Depraved Trinity' inside the Black Core

edges.description: Sin, in Highgate, sends the exile for the ingredients and then brews and opens the Beast with them.
sources: Walkthrough, Sin in Highgate: 'Sin needs you to find some Trarthan Powder and Basilisk Acid'

edges.description: Lilly Roth offers to ferry the exile to Oriath after the Trinity dies.
sources: Walkthrough, Lilly Roth: 'Say the words and we'll set the sails.'

edges.description: Sin burns the new entrance into the Beast's corpse at the Quarry.
sources: Walkthrough: 'Meet Sin at The Quarry, where he will burn open a new entrance'

edges.description: The entrance leads into the Belly of the Beast (Act 9).
sources: Walkthrough: 'Sin has burned open a new entrance into the The Belly of the Beast (Act 9).'

edges.description: Sin burns the Beast's flank with the basilisk acid and powder mixture to open the way in.
sources: Walkthrough: 'I shall apply this fermentation to the weakened membrane'

edges.description: The Depraved Trinity is fought and destroyed in the Rotting Core.
sources: Infobox: 'location = The Rotting Core'; intro: 'the final boss of Act 9, located in The Rotting Core'

edges.description: Sin manifests the Depraved Trinity from the three harvested souls and urges its destruction.
sources: Walkthrough: 'Talk to Sin to manifest the Depraved Trinity'; Sin: 'Destroy that creature of darkness'

edges.description: Shavronne of Umbra is one of the three lieutenants whose combined power forms the Depraved Trinity.
sources: Intro: 'The Trinity is the combined power of the three lieutenants of Malachai... Shavronne of Umbra.'

edges.description: Maligaro is one of the three lieutenants whose combined power forms the Depraved Trinity.
sources: Intro: 'Doedre Stamatis, Maligaro, and Shavronne of Umbra.'

edges.description: Doedre is one of the three lieutenants whose combined power forms the Depraved Trinity.
sources: Intro: 'the three lieutenants of Malachai... Doedre Stamatis, Maligaro, and Shavronne of Umbra.'

edges.description: The exile lands at Oriath Docks, where Lani greets them.
sources: Intro: 'its town is Oriath Docks'; Lani: 'Landing on the docks, the exile is greeted by Lani' (NPC list)

edges.description: Lilly Roth ferries the exile back to Oriath.
sources: Intro: 'the exile returns to Oriath, courtesy of Lilly Roth'

edges.description: Lani describes how Vilenta betrayed her and Bannon and led Kitava's cultists to the Overseer's Tower.
sources: Walkthrough, Lani: 'That witch, Vilenta, is to blame. She lowered a secret ladder'
Intro: 'Landing on the docks, the exile is greeted by Lani'

edges.description: The exile saves Bannon from Kitava's cultists on the Cathedral Rooftop.
sources: Walkthrough: 'Bannon is trapped on the The Cathedral Rooftop (Act 10) by the cultists of Kitava.'

edges.description: Lani asks the exile to find Bannon and return him to her.
sources: Walkthrough, Lani: 'If you are going that way, perhaps you can find him and return him to me.'

edges.description: Kitava's cultists surround Bannon and Lani and are the enemies the exile fights on the rooftop.
sources: Walkthrough, Bannon: 'Kitava's cultists surrounded Lani and I a while back'

edges.description: Bannon meets the exile at the docks with the Staff of Purity and sacrifices himself there to resurrect Innocence.
sources: Walkthrough: 'Bring it to him at the Oriath Docks.'

edges.description: Bannon uses the Staff of Purity and sacrifices himself to host the reborn Innocence.
sources: Walkthrough, Bannon: 'In this act, I will become his host in the fullest sense'; log: 'Bannon has used the Staff of Purity ... and sacrificed himself'

edges.description: Innocence destroys Kitava's Horns at the Ravaged Square.
sources: Walkthrough: 'Meet Innocence at the Horns in the The Ravaged Square'

edges.description: Innocence destroys the black gates blocking the Canals with his power.
sources: Walkthrough, Innocence: 'Innocence will use his power to destroy Kitava's Horns'

edges.description: The exile finds Kitava at his Feeding Trough and kills him there.
sources: Walkthrough: 'You have found Kitava at his Feeding Trough. Talk to Sin to begin the final battle.'

edges.description: Kitava is searched for and destroyed in the Canals.
sources: Walkthrough: 'Search The Canals for Kitava and destroy Kitava, the Insatiable once and for all.'

edges.description: Sin begins the final battle and congratulates the exile after Kitava falls.
sources: Walkthrough, Sin: 'This is it... Go Exile, together we will save humankind!'

edges.description: Innocence, reborn, fights alongside the exile against Kitava.
sources: Walkthrough, Innocence: 'Though my brother and I will aid you, I sense the universe conspires'

edges.description: Lilly Roth offers to sail the exile away from Oriath, with a line tailored to the exile's class.
sources: Walkthrough, Lilly Roth: 'Whaddya say, Marauder? ... Just say the word, and we'll set sail.'

edges.description: The exile reaches Karui Shores and begins the Atlas of Worlds tutorial.
sources: Walkthrough: 'Upon entering Karui Shores for the first time, talk to Helena.'

edges.description: Helena directs the exile to the War Room on Karui Shores.
sources: Walkthrough: 'Upon entering Karui Shores for the first time, talk to Helena. She will direct the player to the War Room'

edges.description: Commander Kirac gives the exile the first Tier 1 map to use on the Map Device.
sources: Walkthrough: 'talk to Commander Kirac. He will give the player a Tier 1 map.'

edges.description: Commander Kirac, in the Karui Shores War Room, gives the Exile the Tier 1 map that starts the Atlas quest.
sources: Walkthrough: 'Upon entering Karui Shores ... War Room ... Commander Kirac ... give the player a Tier 1 map'

edges.description: The commissioning takes place in the Karui Shores War Room.
sources: Walkthrough: 'Upon entering Karui Shores for the first time'

edges.description: The map boss the Exile kills to complete the quest is fought in a Tier 1 Atlas map.
sources: objective: entering the Atlas maps via portals; 'Defeat the Map Boss and return to Commander Kirac'

edges.description: The Shaper, Valdo reduced to a shell, is the subject of the seven memory fragments in this legacy quest.
sources: Assignments: memory fragments of the Shaper

edges.description: The hunt takes place in Shaper-influenced Atlas maps (Tier 2 to 6).
The Shaper is the boss the Exile and Zana defeat in his Realm after the four Guardians are broken.
sources: Walkthrough: 'enter the Shaper's Realm and defeat The Shaper'

edges.description: Zana fights alongside the Exile against the Shaper in his Realm.

edges.description: Dominus's character-creation speech: 'Do you think you are savage enough to face the land of the damned, Marauder?' The Marauder's legacy text names Oriath's chains ('Oriath chained me, made me its slave') but gives no specific crime.

Dominus's character-creation speech: 'You have betrayed the Grand Arena. Now Wraeclast shall be your audience.. and your foe.' The Duelist's legacy text says he killed a high-born lord in a duel ('That lord sang a different tune with six inches of steel in his guts') and was then called a criminal.

Dominus's character-creation speech: 'Swift and silent you stole the bounty of others.' The Ranger's legacy text says Oriath called her a 'poacher' and 'thief' and hauled her 'like cargo into exile' (the stated grievance is poaching).

Dominus's character-creation speech: 'Yours is a predatory profession. The business of butchery.' The Shadow's legacy text describes a contract killing ('Silence a big mouth'); the employers toasted the job and the Shadow was shipped into exile.

Dominus's character-creation speech: 'When a Daughter strays away from the Light, she makes herself an Orphan.' The Witch's legacy text: 'Had they not taken my home with fire, I would not have taken their children.' The stated act is taking children; no formal charge is named.

Dominus's character-creation speech: 'You were once the chosen of God. A Templar. You are now the chosen of Wraeclast. An exile.' The Templar's legacy text: 'They exile me to the land of the damned.' The crime is only hinted at ('only to smite it asunder with one sinful blow'); no specific act is named.

Dominus's character-creation speech: 'But you only gave us Murder and Darkness... Now you will earn your redemption in Wraeclast.' The wiki's own prose (not an in-game quote) says the Scion was exiled for killing her husband on their wedding night.
sources: section 'Character creation' (Dominus speech); intro paragraph (wiki prose)
